name: Clockwork
summary: Brisbane dialup + ADSL ISP (home/business, on-site install/training, hosting); defunct c.2005-06.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 29 Feb 2000 (clockwork.com.au); Brisbane dialup ISP.
Homepage content last changed c. Oct 2005 then stable/unmaintained through the last capture 19 Aug 2006; defunct thereafter.

ACN mismatch: 'Clockwork Solutions Pty Ltd' (ACN 128 842 204) was not registered until 10 Dec 2007, ~7 years after this ISP began and after it went defunct; it is a later name-collision entity, not the operator of clockwork.com.au. Removed from the summary.
